explanation: The ballot of 27 November was brought forward by a week for a reason: the president had dissolved the Assembly on 5 November and the party needed a candidate for prime minister before the campaign. That is what this election chose — not only a leader for the next two years but the name at the head of the largest opposition list on 30 January. The edge is `precondition-of` because the legislative election was already called when this one was held: what the party settled was who would fight it, not that it would happen.
